title: Still Here
description: "still here?" in a tall navy serif, saved as a real JPEG forty times over until the blocks, ringing and purple chroma bleed set in. Type your own line, then hold Save again and watch every re-encode wear it down while the file size drops.
intent: Generation loss as the material: each save is a genuine canvas.toBlob JPEG decoded back onto itself with a sub-pixel wobble, so the artefacts compound exactly like a reposted screenshot.
sources: herb reference board: 51b6830b "still here?" condensed navy serif with JPEG artefacts
